## Goal
WO-226 found that a malformed top-level `generated_at` in the `--previous` file is copied into the new report: `src/freemyid/monitor.py:379` (`previous_generated_at`), recorded as a strict xfail in `tests/codex/test_cx_monitor_previous_hardening.py`.

## Order
Start only after WO-226 is merged (it creates the test file and the strict xfail this WO removes).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. `previous_generated_at` is set only when the previous file's `generated_at` is a string that parses as an ISO 8601 date-time and is at most 40 characters; otherwise it is None. Nothing else from the previous file is copied verbatim into the new report.
2. Remove the `xfail` marker from WO-226's test (the test itself stays and now passes); add cases for a number, a list, a 1 MB string and a date-time with a time zone.
3. Every other monitor behaviour is unchanged: `tests/test_monitor.py` and `tests/codex/test_cx_monitor_contract.py` pass unchanged, and schema `monitor/1` keeps its keys (`monitor.py:376-386`).

This is Codex code-lane work (owner, 2026-11-09): fix and improve the listed module(s) directly, with tests; don't xfail a bug you can fix here. No contract changes: public function signatures, `src/freemyid/models.py`, `interfaces.py`, schema files, `--json` shapes and documented CLI output stay as they are (additive helpers inside the listed files are fine). If the work turns out to need a contract change, stop and say so in VENDOR_STATUS.md "Questions for the owner". Fake data only, offline (fake fetchers, no network), Windows-safe paths in tests (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`, no `/tmp`). Typed, ruff-clean, small diff. Line numbers are from main at the time of writing; re-check them.
